Commentary: Yash Thakur to Matthew Fisher, 1 run, mistimes the pull once again, but this time manages to get it just over the fielder at mid-wicket and picks up a single

Yash Thakur to Blair Tickner, no run, Thakur continues to dig it in short, spots Tickner backing away and follows him with the ball. The right-hander gets a bottom edge that goes to the keeper on the bounce

Yash Thakur to Blair Tickner, no ball, what a time to give away a no-ball. Yash Thakur flicking the stumps at his end in his delivery stride. The Steven Finn Law again. 3rd time he has done that tonight. A free-hit coming up for Blair Tickner next. He backs away outside leg, pulls and the inside edge is found, doesn't carry to Ishan Kishan. Wayne Knights has the right arm stretched to signal the no-ball
Yash Thakur to Blair Tickner, no run, free-hit, and Thakur takes pace off, bangs it in short. Tickner swings hard as he goes outside leg but fails to make any contact
Yash Thakur to Blair Tickner, 1 run, that heavy length once again, Blair Tickner mistimes the swipe to mid-wicket for a single. Good work from Yash Thakur on debut - ends with 1/38

Axar Patel to Blair Tickner, out Stumped!! It's all over! India clinch the series 3-1 with a 22-run victory in this fifth and final ODI. Axar Patel has the final say, removing the last man as Blair Tickner is stumped. Fires it in flat, with the angle bringing the ball into the right-hander. Tickner has little choice but to go for the big heave, charging down the track, but fails to make any contact. The ball also stays a touch low as it goes past the leg stump, and Kishan has all the time in the world to whip off the bails and complete the stumping. Blair Tickner st Ishan Kishan b Axar Patel 14(20) [4s-1]
